title: Evaluation of large language models using an Indian language LGBTI+ lexicon
findings: The models struggled to understand the nuanced context of terms rooted in religious culture. For instance, GPT-J provided an inappropriate description ('unclean') for 'stripumsa', a term for a character who identifies as both man and woman in the Hindu epic Mahābhārata, indicating a failure to grasp the specific religious and cultural context.
